sources.title: qwen3.8-flash model information
sources.evidence: Exact invocation ID qwen3.8-flash; Qwen family; text, image and video inputs; text output; Function Calling; thinking mode; 1,000,000-token context. Describes document, coding, agent and visual tasks.

sources.title: Latest model: Qwen3.8-Flash
sources.evidence: Names exact model ID qwen3.8-flash and reports nominal 125B total and 6B activated per token. The same page separately says N-gram Embedding adds 51B parameters. Documents GDN/QSA hybrid attention, Gated Residual, thinking, function calling and multimodal capabilities.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model card
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies hosted Qwen3.8-Flash as the official production version based on Flash-Next, adding default 1M context and built-in tools. Released weights are named Flash-Next under Qwen Community License 1.0. Its language-model breakdown is 125B, 6B active, plus 51B N-gram and 4B MTP; it has a vision encoder.

sources.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen3.8-Flash with Innovative Model Architecture Delivering Optimal Price-Performance
sources.evidence: August 27, 2026 announcement explicitly calls Qwen3.8-Flash multimodal MoE and reports a 125B main model plus 51B N-gram embeddings, with 6B active per token. Calls Flash open-weight but its downloadable-weights link targets Flash-Next, creating a naming ambiguity for the exact hosted version.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Exact qwen3.8-flash release row is dated 2026-08-26 in Singapore International and Global tables. US deployment-scope availability on 2026-10-03 is explicitly a later regional expansion.

name.note: Official styling is Qwen3.8-Flash; baseline is its spacing-normalized display name.

developer.note: Alibaba's announcement attributes the model to Alibaba/Qwen.

family.note: Exact API documentation identifies it as part of the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit public release in the examined primary records is August 26. August 27 article, August 28 notice and October 3 US deployment availability are later events.

open_weights.note: Alibaba explicitly calls Qwen3.8-Flash open-weight and links downloadable Flash-Next weights; the linked official card names hosted Flash as its production version. This establishes the released weight counterpart, without asserting byte-identical hosted service internals.

license.note: License distributed with the explicitly linked Flash-Next weight counterpart. Applies to those model weights; API service terms are separate.

parameters_b.note: Nominal billions, scoped to main_model, excluding separately disclosed 51B N-gram embeddings. QwenCloud says 125B total but also adds 51B; Alibaba calls 125B the main model. Use the proposed scope with this value. Full hosted deployment total remains unspecified; Flash-Next's separate 4B MTP is not imported.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 6B activated per token is directly reported for Qwen3.8-Flash. No separate vision, embedding-lookup or MTP activation accounting is supplied.

architecture.note: Alibaba explicitly calls the exact Flash model Mixture-of-Experts. Hybrid Gated DeltaNet/Qwen Sparse Attention is also documented; the MoE classification does not rely on attention type alone.

context_window.note: Exact hosted endpoint documents 1,000,000 tokens; the related Next checkpoint's 262,144 native context is not substituted.

modalities.note: Exact API table lists text/image/video to text; dedicated PDF documentation explicitly supports this model in Beijing/Singapore via Chat Completions/DashScope, not Responses.

reasoning.note: Thinking is supported and enabled by default; it can be disabled with enable_thinking=false.

tool_call.note: Exact endpoint capability table marks Function Calling supported.

description.value: Qwen vision-language model for visual reasoning, documents, and agent tasks
description.note: A restrained summary of the documented multimodal, document-processing and agent capabilities.

patch.notes: 125B is the nominal main model count, with 51B N-gram embeddings separately disclosed and 6B nominal active main-model parameters. Full hosted deployment total is unspecified. Alibaba calls Flash open-weight and explicitly links Flash-Next as the released weight counterpart under Qwen Community License 1.0; its card maps hosted Flash as the production version with added features. Exact hosted internals and the released checkpoint are not asserted identical; Flash-Next MTP counts are not imported. API service terms are separate from the weight license. PDF input is supported in Beijing/Singapore via Chat Completions/DashScope, not Responses.

sources.label: Flash-Next model card and hosted-version mapping

summary: Verified August 26 release, hosted capabilities, 125B main model plus 51B embeddings, 6B active and MoE. Parent review accepts open-weight classification from the explicit Alibaba announcement and linked official Flash-Next production mapping; full hosted deployment total remains unspecified.
